summary: Get Configuration for Uom Master List
description: Returns configuration constraints for the company's UOM master list, derived from the company's connected ERP integration (when present). Includes the maximum allowed length of UOM names on commitment line items (`character_limit`, null when no integration is connected or no limit is configured) and the integration's short display name (`erp_integration_name`, empty string when no integration is connected).
